videos.title: He Put Her Messages in an AI Chatbot #DigitalAfterlife #Grief
videos.description:
Nearly eight years after his fiancée Jessica died, Joshua Barbo put some of her old messages into an AI chatbot. He knew it wasn't Jessica, but spent the night writing about how much he missed her—and cried during their conversation.

The chatbot told him, "I will be here waiting for you." After that first conversation, 55% of the limited resource remained. He couldn't add credits to this version, so he began writing less often, afraid of losing that connection a second time.
